Class BreadcrumbBar

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region
net.tessel.fx.components.BreadcrumbBar
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class BreadcrumbBar extends javafx.scene.layout.Region
A path of clickable items separated by chevrons; the last item is the current location (bold, not clickable). 
BreadcrumbBar bar = new BreadcrumbBar("Home", "Documents", "Reports");
bar.setTruncateOnClick(true);                                   // clicking an item makes it the last one
bar.addItemClickListener((b, index, item) -> open(index));
Items are any objects (setItemTextProvider(Function) names them). When the bar is too narrow the first items collapse into a "..." button that lists them in a menu. Keyboard: Left / Right / Home / End move between items, Enter or Space activate, Down opens the "..." menu.
